temperature: Post-hoc probability temperature, not generation sampling. Same T applied to branch distributions for blind/condition. condition_ternary separately rescales A/B/C before normalizing support. Floored probabilities cannot recover underflowed logits.
uniform: uniform branch mass + sum equals action frequency exactly; deterministic ties pick first option, random tie expectation also reported.
counts: sum/max/mean, exact condition+action deduplication, single-rule duplication sensitivity. Uniform option expected chance is 1/number_options; no model inference.
mismatch: Within-tree donor chosen by hash among different patient texts, without gold labels. Same disease tree avoids trivial cross-disease mismatch. Targets retained for diagnostic degradation only; not asserted to be donor truth.
